firstMismatch.message: dmonsfree: 1 removed does not match 0 pending

summary: The admitted prefix matches through the monster reading the Earth scroll. C then drops a boulder on a mold and calls mon.c:mondied after the non-player kill message. JavaScript previously recorded mondied as unported, leaving the dead monster attached and causing a later dmonsfree failure. Awaiting the existing JavaScript mondied implementation now reproduces the death and corpse path; the complete v76 recording matches.

source.branch: When the boulder reduces a monster below one hit point, drop_boulder_on_monster calls killed for a hero-caused death; otherwise it prints the killed message and calls mon.c:mondied. The selected MUSE_SCR_EARTH caller passes byu=false for every square in its surrounding-square loop.
callers: muse.c:use_offensive handles MUSE_SCR_EARTH, consumes the scroll, then calls read.c:drop_boulder_on_monster(x, y, confused, FALSE) for suitable neighboring squares.
js/muse.js:use_offensive reaches js/read.js:drop_boulder_on_monster with byu=false while simulating the monster's Earth scroll action.

js/read.js:drop_boulder_on_monster currently emits the non-player kill message and records note_unported('mon.c mondied'); the existing js/mon.js:mondied implementation calls mondead, then corpse_chance and make_corpse when appropriate.

evidence: The v76 admission evaluation records the full case as stopped with error dmonsfree: 1 removed does not match 0 pending. The saved accepted-boundary prefix in /home/vtjeng/development/vtjeng/teleport-contest/.cache/prep40-recovery/prep76/logs/accepted-boundary-prefix-v76-monster-earth-mold-action3.json matches 2,479 RNG calls, 404 screens, and 404 cursors before the error.

C read.c:drop_boulder_on_monster at lines 2341-2410 subtracts boulder damage and, when byu is false and DEADMONSTER is true, prints the kill message and calls mondied(mtmp). C mon.c:mondied at lines 3253-3263 calls mondead, then creates a corpse only when the monster remains dead and corpse_chance plus terrain eligibility permit it.
C muse.c:use_offensive at lines 1899-1934 consumes MUSE_SCR_EARTH and calls drop_boulder_on_monster with FALSE for suitable neighboring squares, establishing the selected production entry point.

Before this change, JavaScript js/read.js:drop_boulder_on_monster at lines 2438-2446 mirrored the non-player kill message but recorded note_unported('mon.c mondied'). JavaScript js/mon.js:mondied already implemented the C death/corpse flow and was imported by other production callers; read.js already imported related mon.js functions from that module.

The implementation imports and awaits mondied(monster, state, env) at this non-player-death branch. The updated scripts/read-earth.test.mjs pins that call before wake_nearto. The exact admitted v76 replay and synthetic-range-evidence check both match all 584 screens, 2,567 RNG calls, and 584 cursors with no error.
